name: kybase
description: Persistent Markdown memory for AI agents: notes you can read and edit, with hybrid search.
long_description: Kybase gives your agent a long-term memory you own: a Markdown knowledge base with [[wikilinks]], searched by keyword and by meaning. Notes live in an embedded Postgres on your machine (no Docker, no server) and leave it only if you pick a cloud embedding provider. `kybase-mcp export vault.zip` writes them out as plain Markdown; the full Kybase app adds a web editor, a graph view and access for several agents at once.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where the knowledge base lives. Created on first start.

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: ollama (local), google or openai. Needed for search by meaning; keyword search works without it.

ollama_url.title: Ollama URL
ollama_url.description: Local Ollama endpoint. Run `ollama pull embeddinggemma` once.

google_api_key.title: Google API key
google_api_key.description: Only with provider google. Sends note text to Google to compute embeddings.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Only with provider openai. Sends note text to OpenAI to compute embeddings.
